note: The actor contract sends 0.275616 WETH into a five-pool chain: WETH to REVV (V3), REVV to PROS (V2), PROS to USDC (V2), USDC to SAITO (V3), then SAITO back to WETH (V2). Each pool forwards directly to the next, and the last returns 0.280853 WETH to the actor, so the actor touches only WETH and holds nothing else. The gross gain of 0.005237 WETH minus the 0.005053 ETH fee leaves only about +0.000184 ETH, which is positive but very thin.
